kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
حممت (form I)
# حَمَمْتُ (ḥamamtu) /ħa.mam.tu/: first-person singular past active of حَمَّ (ḥamma)
# حَمَمْتَ (ḥamamta) /ħa.mam.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of حَمَّ (ḥamma)
# حَمَمْتِ (ḥamamti) /ħa.mam.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of حَمَّ (ḥamma)
# حُمِمْتُ (ḥumimtu) /ħu.mim.tu/: first-person singular past passive of حَمَّ (ḥamma)
# حُمِمْتَ (ḥumimta) /ħu
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
